svg.title: PinWright
svg.desc: PinWright is an MCP server inside the Unreal Editor for AI coding agents. Example requests: build the settings menu from this mockup; make a forest level with a river and a cabin; why did the HUD go blank in the last playtest.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: MCP PLUGIN FOR THE UNREAL EDITOR
An MCP server inside the live
Unreal Editor, for AI coding agents.
Your agent reads the project as text,
authors assets, and you review every change.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: things you can ask your agent to do
"Build the settings menu from this mockup."
widget tree, styles and bindings, authored in UMG
"Make a forest level with a river and a cabin."
landscape, foliage, sky and props, placed by measurement
"Why did the HUD go blank in the last playtest?"
answered from the recorded play session
